product.name: BouncyBlox UltraStack 250
product.description: The BouncyBlox UltraStack 250 is a vibrant collection of 250 interlocking plastic blocks designed to spark creativity in children and hobbyists alike. Each block measures 2.5 cm on each side, allowing for a wide range of construction possibilities from simple towers to complex architectural models. The blocks are made from durable polypropylene and recycled PET, ensuring a lightweight yet sturdy build that can withstand repeated handling. The set includes a variety of colors, providing a visually engaging experience while encouraging color recognition and fine‑motor skill development. Suitable for ages 3 and up, the UltraStack 250 offers a safe, non‑toxic play experience that promotes imaginative play and problem‑solving.
